title: [Decision] Split the platform's largest, fastest-growing source files (protocol.ts 32,428 lines, +10,002 in 30 days) the way rest-server.ts was split, or leave them
body:
Filing gate ②, a decision only the maintainer can make. The maintainer's word in `domain:cli` seat 1's session chat, verbatim: 「应该立决策卡研究如何分解这些大的文件」. It followed this seat's measurement of `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` while #24535 waited on a same-function PR.

Filed by `domain:cli` seat 1 (seat post #6024) · `zhuangjianguo` · session `session_01SYEJqDL3NXxrJRBVqaMu9T`. ⛔ Not a claim. **Reader who acts:** the maintainer, who decides here; then the owning lanes' seats, one card per file.

## 维护者速读

- **问题:** 平台最核心、改得最勤的几块代码,集中在少数几个超大文件里,而且还在快速变大。不同车道的改动频繁撞进同一个文件、甚至同一个函数,只能排队一个一个落地。今天的实例是:p1 的读性能修复 #24535,在等 engine 车道一个无关 PR 改完同一个函数。
- **规模:** `protocol.ts` 32,428 行,30 天内增加 10,002 行、184 次提交;`objectql/engine.ts` 22,232 行(+6,195);`conversions/registry.ts` 17,722 行(+7,760)。
- **先例:** 2026-10 按您的指示拆过 `rest-server.ts`(#23050):18 个只搬代码的分片 PR,约 6 天,13,701 行降到 6,196 行,期间没有出过事故。
- **推荐 A:** 照 #23050 的做法,逐个文件、按车道立卡分片拆,先从 `protocol.ts` 开始。不新增门禁。
- **您要做的一个动作:** 回一个字母(A / B / C / D)。

## Measured (on `origin/main` `ba4afcc23`, 2026-10-19)

| file | lines | change in 30 days | commits 7d / 30d | open PRs on it now | owning lane |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|:--|:--|
| `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` | 32,428 | +10,002 (from 22,426) | 67 / 184 | PR #24533 | `domain:engine` |
| `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` | 22,232 | +6,195 | 20 / 111 | none | `domain:engine` |
| `packages/drivers/driver-sql/src/sql-driver.ts` | 21,570 | +2,193 | 4 / 52 | none | `domain:engine` |
| `packages/spec/src/conversions/registry.ts` | 17,722 | +7,760 | 23 / 77 | none | `domain:spec` |
| `packages/services/service-automation/src/engine.ts` | 13,530 | +2,067 | 11 / 44 | PR #24527 | `domain:services` |
| `packages/rest/src/rest-server.ts` (split by #23050) | 6,196 | −7,816 | — | — | `domain:cli` |

- Eleven more non-test source files sit between 5,000 and 10,000 lines, among them `plugin-security/src/security-plugin.ts` (9,705), `plugin-auth/src/auth-manager.ts` (9,641) and `spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts` (8,823, 101 commits in 30 days).
- Re-check: `git show origin/main:<path> | wc -l`; `git log --since='30 days ago' --oneline origin/main -- <path> | wc -l`; and the same at `git rev-list -1 --before='30 days ago' origin/main` for growth.
- **The collision measured today:** PR #24533 (`Fixes #10757`) rewrites `readMetaItem`'s item-read cache in `protocol.ts` (hunks about `:11141`–`:11436`). #24535 needs an item-level execution read in the same function (`:11300`–`:11920`). By the seats' hard-serial rule, #24535 waits for #24533's merge (record `6269601173`).
- **What an agent can read:** `protocol.ts` is 1.9 MB. A dev agent's file reader returns 2,000 lines per call, so no agent ever reads this file whole; every edit is made with a partial view of a 32,000-line class.

**Governing text:** none found. `git grep -n -i -E "max-lines|file size|god (file|class)|split (the|a) (file|module)|monolith"` over `AGENTS.md`, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`, `docs/adr` and the ESLint configs finds no source-file size rule. The hits are about package and ownership monoliths (ADR-0028, ADR-0029), not file size. No protocol (spec) declaration changes in any option.

**Prior rulings read:** #23050, the maintainer's 「这个文件经常改，为什么不分拆？rest-server.ts」, then 「立卡，等 #22877 后 (推荐)」. One move-only slice per PR, with gates and doc anchors migrated in the same PR; `/meta` was held until the conflicting engine PR merged. It landed 18 slices (#23116 … #24304, `d1f082d94`), +17,258 / −9,553 including the moved tests and anchors.

## Options

| | what it does | what a customer notices | workload |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **A** | One `[maintainer]` card per file over 10,000 lines, in its owning lane, split along the file's existing seams by move-only slices, #23050's rules. `protocol.ts` first, then `objectql/engine.ts` and `conversions/registry.ts`, then the other two. Each slice is serial with the file's in-flight PRs. | Nothing directly. Fixes stop queuing behind unrelated work in the same file sooner, and agents' edits are made with the whole module in view. | Measured precedent: #23050, 18 PRs in about 6 days for 13,701 → 6,196 lines (one lane). `protocol.ts` is 2.4× rest-server's starting size, so there is no precedent at that size; expect several lanes in parallel over weeks, with each lane's queue share going to move-only PRs. |
| **B** | A, plus a new gate: no non-test source file may grow past a line ceiling (a ratchet, as `check-skill-line-ratchet` does for `SKILL.md`). | The same as A, and the files cannot grow back. | A, plus one gate script, its ceiling table and its CI wiring. 「新增门禁默认否」: this needs the maintainer to name it. |
| **C** | Split only where it hurts: when a card is held by a same-file or same-function serial wait, its seat first moves that seam out in a move-only PR, then does the fix. No program. | Slower relief: only the hot spots get smaller, as they are hit. | No upfront program. Each such card grows by one move-only PR. No precedent. |
| **D** | Leave the files as they are. | Same-file waits keep growing with the files: `protocol.ts` gained 10,002 lines in 30 days. | None now. |

## 四轴分析

- **项目长远合理性:** 两年后,一个成熟的元数据平台,其核心协议层应当是按职责划分的模块,而不是一个 3 万行的类。主流框架的做法都是一类职责一个模块,例如 NestJS 的 module、Django 的 app、Salesforce 平台内部按服务划分。A 一次付清;C 只还热点上的债,冷区会继续长;D 让债以每月约一万行的速度累积。#23050 证明了"只搬代码、逐片落地"在这个仓库行得通,而且没有出过事故。
- **实际业务拉动:** 有实测拉动。今天一个 p1 修复就排在无关 PR 后面;`protocol.ts` 7 天 67 次提交,意味着多个车道每天都在同一个文件上串行。拉动是开发吞吐,不是客户功能;客户感受到的是修复变慢。
- **防 AI 犯错:** 这是 A 最强的一条理由。AI 开发者每次只能读到 2,000 行,在 3 万行的类里改代码,看不到同一个类里的其他调用点和不变量,出错时往往是静默的(例如漏改一个兄弟分支)。拆成按职责的模块后,一个模块能整篇读完,改动面和评审面都变小。B 的门禁能防止文件再长回去,但它是新增门禁。
- **创业阶段不扩散:** A 不新增任何对外声明、键或接口,纯内部重构;代价是车道队列份额,#23050 期间 cli 车道约有 6 天主要在做搬迁。B 新增一个永久门禁,违背「新增门禁默认否」,除非您点名。C 最省,但债不会减少。

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:A 一次按职责拆清;C 只拆热点、冷区照长;D 每月约万行累积;B 同 A 并防反弹。
- ② 实际业务拉动:有——今天 p1 #24535 因同函数串行而等待;protocol.ts 7 天 67 次提交。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:A 让一个模块能被整篇读完,结构上更难改错;D 让每次改动都在部分视野下进行。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:A 不新增声明面与门禁;B 新增永久门禁(默认否);C 最省但不还债。
Prior rulings read: "split" "rest-server.ts" "large file" "decompose" → #23050 (maintainer, move-only slices), #2462 (ADR-0076 layering, closed); ADR none on file size; thread: none

自检:只看①选 A;②③④ 是否翻转:否(④ 只调时序:先 protocol.ts,其余随车道余量分期)。

**推荐:A。** 回退:C(若车道余量不足以支撑分片计划)。**置信缺口:** `protocol.ts` 内部的接缝还没有像 #23050 那样逐段实测(哪些方法簇可以按职责独立搬出、彼此的私有依赖有多深);规模是 rest-server 起点的 2.4 倍,分片数和周期是估计,不是实测。

## 裁后执行

- **A:** this seat files one `[maintainer]` card per file over 10,000 lines into its owning lane, quoting the ruling.
  - Each card starts with #23050's measurement: the file's sections, the lines each holds, the lines each gained in the last 30 days, and the scripts, anchors and docs that read the file by path.
  - The first slice of `protocol.ts` follows PR #24533's merge, and #24535 is dispatched before it.
  - Each slice is move-only, migrates its gates and doc anchors in the same PR, and is serial with the file's in-flight PRs.
- **B:** as A, plus one `domain:skills` / `tooling` card for the line-ceiling gate, quoting the maintainer's naming of it.
- **C:** a line in each lane's seat charter: a card held by a same-file serial wait moves its seam out first, as its own move-only PR.
- **D:** this card closes `not_planned`. Reopening it is free.
